shoulder_diameter = 6.0
shoulder_radius = shoulder_diameter / 2.0
knurl_length = 20.0

chamfer_size = 0.8

counterbore_depth = 3.0

with BuildPart() as p:

        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (shoulder_radius, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (shoulder_radius, shoulder_length))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (rod_radius, shoulder_length))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (rod_radius, rod_length - knurl_length))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (shoulder_radius, rod_length - knurl_length))
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (shoulder_radius, rod_length))
            l7 = Line(l6 @ 1, (0, rod_length))
            l8 = Line(l7 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

solid_body = p.part

bottom_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[0]
solid_body = chamfer(bottom_face.edges(), chamfer_size)

hole = Pos(0, 0, hole_offset) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, rod_diameter * 2)
